scenarios.title: 前台办卡
scenarios.setting: 下班后你走进附近健身房，向柜台询问体验和月卡价格。

lines.en: Hi, I'd like to get a membership.
lines.zh: 你好，我想办一张会员卡。
lines.speak: Hi, I'd like to get a membership.

lines.en: Sure. Is there a plan you're interested in?
lines.speak: Sure. Is there a plan you're interested in?

lines.en: Is there a free trial first?
lines.speak: Is there a free trial first?

lines.en: Yes, you can try it today. A monthly pass is sixty dollars.
lines.zh: 可以，今天就能体验。月卡六十美元。
lines.speak: Yes, you can try it today. A monthly pass is sixty dollars.

lines.en: That sounds good. Where is the locker room?
lines.zh: 听起来不错。更衣室在哪？
lines.speak: That sounds good. Where is the locker room?

scenarios.title: 向教练请教
scenarios.setting: 你想跑步并预约团课，向教练确认器械用法和今晚是否还有名额。

lines.en: Excuse me, is this treadmill free?
lines.zh: 不好意思，这台跑步机有人用吗？
lines.speak: Excuse me, is this treadmill free?

lines.en: Yes, it is. You should stretch first.
lines.speak: Yes, it is. You should stretch first.

lines.en: Could you show me how to use this machine?
lines.zh: 能教我怎么用这台器械吗？
lines.speak: Could you show me how to use this machine?

lines.en: Of course. Start slow, then speed up.
lines.speak: Of course. Start slow, then speed up.

lines.en: Thanks. Can I book a class for tonight?
lines.zh: 谢谢。今晚的课还可以预约吗？
lines.speak: Thanks. Can I book a class for tonight?

task: 把办卡和请教教练两段对话连着说一遍并录音自听
